CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 122

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 25

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

5. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

6. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 17

9. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 7
   C. 11
   D. 8

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 12
   D. 13

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 49
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49
Final Answer: 49
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11

Final Answer: 121
